title: Mission V1.4 canonical registration and trust freeze
description: Register the byte-frozen EQCOFE Multi-Agent V1.4 Execution Mission, bind its exact SHA-256 in the mission registry, create the governance log entry, freeze the resolved Trust Model identities, regenerate the deterministic Task Catalog, and establish the governed Stage B handoff without starting Item 10 implementation.

why_medium: This task creates canonical governance artifacts that freeze the mission execution order and trust identities used by later production-gate tasks.
An incorrect mission hash, registry entry, trust identity, or Stage B handoff could create governance drift even though no product runtime is modified.
why_not_high: The task is documentation/governance-only and does not mutate runtime code, workflows, rulesets, merge-policy controller behavior, database, auth, payment, pricing, inventory, or production state.
Human Gate is not required for MEDIUM unless deterministic classification escalates.

dependencies.name: Item 9 canonical closure and Item 10 authorization

acceptance_criteria.description: The V1.4 mission file is present at the declared path with MISSION_SPEC_STATUS=FROZEN and its exact UTF-8 byte SHA-256 equals the Task Contract and registry value.
REGISTRY.md records V1.4, exact mission filename, exact SHA-256, UTC registration timestamp and FROZEN status.
GOVERNANCE-LOG.md records Owner authorization, Stage A completion, Trust Model identities and fail-closed Stage B handoff.

Trust Model values match live canonical enforcement: checks verify/phase-a/merge-policy, GitHub Actions integration 15368, ruleset 23278861, EQCOFE_GATE_V1 owner-authored evidence and Merge Policy Enforcement workflow_dispatch merge transport.
The registration task does not fabricate an Item 10 executable specification or start Item 10 implementation; missing specification remains a blocking B1 outcome.

The exact write artifact is limited to the five declared governance paths. No active open PR overlaps the mission paths at r2 creation; canonical PR #209 is already incorporated in the base and its Task Catalog row is preserved.
The generated Task Catalog includes MA-MISSION-V1-4-REGISTRATION-001 and indexes 37 Task Contracts exactly.
Exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Merge Policy, artifact-bound Review PASS and ACTIVE Lock all pass before protected canonical merge.
Mission V1.4 canonical registration is complete only after protected workflow merge and exact-SHA post-merge canonical plus Phase A verification pass.

external_gate_evidence.rule: MEDIUM registration requires exact-artifact Review PASS plus ACTIVE Lock; Security and Human Gate are not required unless deterministic risk escalates.
